order: [jar] There is no progression spine. supplementaries is a wide, flat pile of small utilities and decorations, all craftable from ordinary early-game materials.

[jar] the genuinely FUNCTIONAL items, which are what a quest should target rather than the colour variants: supplementaries:sack (portable storage), supplementaries:safe (locked storage, paired with supplementaries:key), supplementaries:quiver, supplementaries:rope and supplementaries:rope_arrow (traversal), supplementaries:slingshot, supplementaries:pedestal, supplementaries:item_shelf, supplementaries:notice_board, supplementaries:hourglass, supplementaries:clock_block, supplementaries:altimeter, supplementaries:cannon with supplementaries:cannonball, supplementaries:bomb, supplementaries:spring_launcher, supplementaries:turn_table, supplementaries:crank, supplementaries:speaker_block, supplementaries:bellows, supplementaries:blackboard, supplementaries:cage, supplementaries:jar, supplementaries:planter, supplementaries:faucet, supplementaries:soap.
[jar] supplementaries:sign_post and supplementaries:wind_vane are the signature 'village character' pieces; supplementaries:globe is the trophy-grade one.
gates: [jar] Nothing hard. supplementaries:flax and supplementaries:flax_block are the one small crop chain, feeding rope.
[jar] supplementaries:ash / supplementaries:ash_brick come from burning things, which is the only real 'unlock' in the mod.
structures: [jar] supplementaries:way_sign - roadside signposts that generate in the world pointing at villages. The mod's only worldgen.
traps: [jar] The id list is dominated by colour variants - 16 awnings, 16 buntings, 16 flags, 17 candle holders, 15 presents and 14 trapped presents. Quest generation MUST filter these or the questline becomes a colour swatch. Target the base id (supplementaries:awning, supplementaries:bunting, supplementaries:present) and ignore the _colour suffixes.
